text_block_list.text:
After training, while watching the other
Umamusume on the track—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Trainer?
Why are you still here—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "...Wait, were you watching other girls?Even though you just finished training with me?!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Geez, no way, no way!
You're *my* Trainer, aren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Can't be helped! I'll be nice and run one extra lap just for today!"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
âShould you be looking at the other girls, or at me?
See for yourself with your own eyes.
choice_data_list: Shall we give it a try, then?
There's no need to even compare.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Hmph, you're still gonna cop that kind of attitude with me?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Understood, I'll show you right now.
Just how I run.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
"And remember this:
I'm Tokai Teio, after all!"
True to her word, Tokai Teio put on a magnificent running performance.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: "Hmm? Does that mean you'll be watching both?"

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, it's pretty obvious, though.
Just wanna double-check my answer, y'know?
She headed back looking quite happy.
